HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. A mixture of two liquids

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Hygiene and Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Food Hygiene and Safety.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Hygiene and Safety.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Hygiene and Safety.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Hygiene and Safety.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

8. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

9. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. pascal (Pa)

10. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Clothing Construction Processes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Overview of Home Science and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Kitchen Layouts and Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Food Hygiene and Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
